description_en: Retrieves file detection results in batches by HashKey
description_zh: 通过HashKey批量获取文件检测结果
name: GetFileDetectResult

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The list of file identifiers. A maximum of 100 elements can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 文件标识列表。最多传入100个元素
parameters.name: hash_key_list

parameters.help_en:
The type of file to detect. Valid values:

0: malicious file detection
parameters.help_zh:
需要检测的文件类型。取值：

0：恶意文件检测
parameters.name: type

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Compress.description_en:
Indicates whether the file is identified as a compressed archive.

true: Yes.

false: No.

This parameter is not supported when Type is 6
Compress.description_zh:
是否识别为压缩包。

true：是。

false：否。

Type为6时不支持此参数

Ext.description_en: The extended information of the detection result

Message.description_en: The detailed information of the error code

Result.description_en:
The file detection result. Valid values:

0: Safe file.
1: Suspicious file.
3: Detection in progress. Wait for the result
Result.description_zh:
文件检测结果。取值：

0：安全文件
1：可疑文件
3：检测中，请等待

Score.description_en:
The file detection score. The mapping between score ranges and risk levels is as follows:

0-60: Safe.
61-70: Risky.
71-80: Suspicious.
81-100: Malicious.

<notice>A higher score indicates a more suspicious file.></notice>
Score.description_zh:
文件检测分数。分数区间及危险等级的对应关系如下：

0~60：安全
61~70：风险
71~80：可疑
81~100：恶意

<notice>分数越高，文件越可疑。></notice>

VirusType.description_en:
The virus type. Valid values:

Trojan: trojan
WebShell: web shell
Backdoor: backdoor
RansomWare: ransomware
Scanner: scanner
Stealer: credential stealer
Malbaseware: contaminated base software
Hacktool: hacking tool
Engtest: DPI engine test program
Downloader: downloader trojan
Virus: file infector virus
Miner: mining programs
Worm: worms
DDoS: DDoS Trojan
Malware: malware
RiskWare: riskware
Proxytool: proxy tool
Suspicious: suspicious program
MalScript: malicious script
Rootkit: rootkit
Exploit: vulnerability exploits

This parameter is not supported when Result is 0 or 3

病毒类型。取值：

Trojan：木马程序
WebShell：网站后门
Backdoor：后门程序
RansomWare：勒索病毒
Scanner：扫描器
Stealer：窃密工具
Malbaseware：被污染的基础软件
Hacktool：黑客工具
Engtest：引擎测试程序
Downloader：下载器木马
Virus：感染型病毒
Miner：挖矿程序
Worm：蠕虫病毒
DDoS：DDoS木马
Malware：恶意程序
RiskWare：风险软件
Proxytool：代理工具
Suspicious：可疑程序
MalScript：恶意脚本
Rootkit：Rootkit
Exploit：漏洞利用程序

Result为0或3时不支持此参数
